title: Resend template window
description: A centred icon tile, lit title, lead and a graphite button beside a text link, over a wide 24px-radius code window: traffic-light dots and device/theme toggles on top, a file list on the left (the open file in blue), a numbered template listing in small mono, and a rendered-preview slot on the right. Phones show the files as tabs and only the preview.
notes: the preview pane and the icon tile are media slots: placeholders until filled
name: resend-react

props.name: title
props.description: the title; a list sets its desktop line breaks

props.name: text
props.description: the lead; a list sets its desktop line breaks

props.name: media
props.description: fills the icon slot above the title; empty shows a placeholder tile

props.name: files
props.description: template files in the side list; the open one is highlighted

props.name: code
props.description: the part of the open file shown in the code pane

props.name: startLine
props.description: number of the code's first line

props.name: preview
props.description: the rendered email beside the code; empty shows a placeholder
